title: The state fish of the Kern
text: The golden trout has been California's official freshwater state fish since 1947. California golden trout are native to two stream systems on the eastern side of the Kern River: Golden Trout Creek and the South Fork Kern River. The fish was named for Agua Bonita Waterfall, where the first specimens were collected. In 1876, 13 golden trout were put in a coffee can and carried to Cottonwood Creek.
